set.body:
Deliver WP-16 using optional components over the supported pinned-release API. Prove the workflow from a synthetic accepted release through an aggregate query and verified withdrawal from a private node.

The base Sanctity distribution and the core demo have independent acceptance. Outbound federation search is optional. A production deployment or public listing has its own qualification.

Source: docs/implementation-plan.md, External discovery through Neurobagel. Requirements E-02, O-02, AT-11.
set.title: EP15: Discover an approved Sanctity release through Neurobagel
